IssueFilterSet.leaves: exact/choice filters per field incl. state, priority, assignee, label, module, cycle, dates, created_by; ported as leaf predicates under the compiled tree

assignee_array.renders: assignee subquery returns ONLY soft-deleted-filtered rows; NO active-member filter on issues/ paths

backend: ComplexFilterBackend parses the `filter=` JSON tree (and/or/nest) into Q objects; IssueFilterSet resolves leaf keys; both apply on top of get_queryset (base.py:86-87, 205)

label_array.renders: label subquery returns ONLY soft-deleted-filtered rows

legacy_issue_filters.compiler: issue_filters(query_params, method) -> Q predicate; per-field helpers filter_state, filter_priority, filter_assignees, filter_labels, ... each take (params, issue_filter, method, prefix)
legacy_issue_filters.note: applies on issues-detail/ BEFORE the Exists permission (base.py:1041-1043); suite sends no legacy params on list paths so the compiler is implemented but live-unverified beyond unit tests

manager.renders: Issue.issue_objects = IssueManager() (db/models/issue.py:229): base filter excludes drafts AND archived from the default list (suite: total_count==3, I4 draft + I5 archived absent)

module_array.divergence: Django module subquery checks deleted+archived on the LINK but has NO module-deleted check; Rust adds m.deleted_at IS NULL — DIVERGENCE recorded for fix
module_array.renders: module subquery returns link-deleted+link-archived-filtered rows (NO module.deleted_at check)

order_by.default: -created_at; ?order_by= flows into order_issue_queryset verbatim; paginator re-orders grouped windows after grouping

ordering.renders: ORDER BY <key> [DESC] with NULLS handling per Django default; applied AFTER annotations so annotation aliases are orderable

sub_issues_count.renders: count of non-deleted children -> sub_issues_count (suite asserts I1 == 1)

tenant_scope.renders: WHERE workspace__slug = %s AND project_id = %s on EVERY list-family queryset (flat :~98, viewset :210-216, detail, deleted :817)

updated_at__gt.deleted: filters={updated_at__gt: ...} only when the param is present (base.py:816-818)
updated_at__gt.v2: updated_at = GET.get('updated_at__gt', None), applied as updated_at__gt filter when present (base.py:~881)
